versions.content: Service Name Key M_ Prepare Syntax Std_ Return Type Key M_ Prepare ( const uint8* Request Data, uint16 Request Data Length, uint8* Response Data, uint16* Response Data Length ) Service ID [hex] 0x05 Sync/ Async Synchronous Specification of Key Manager AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 30 of 134 Document ID 907 : AUTOSAR_SWS_KeyManager - AUTOSAR confidential - Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) Request Data Information that comes along with the request Request Data Length Length of data in the Request Data array Parameters (inout) Response Data Length In: Max number of bytes available in Response Data Out: Actual number of bytes Parameters (out) Response Data Data returned by the function. Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: Service has been accepted and will be processed internally. Results will be provided through a callback E_ NOT_ OK: Service not accepted due to an internal error. KEYM_ E_ PARAMETER_ MISMATCH: Parameter do not match with expected value. KEYM_ E_ KEY_ CERT_ SIZE_ MISMATCH: Parameter size doesn't match Description This function is used to prepare a key update operation. The main intent is to provide information for the key operation to the key server. Other operations may start the negotiation for a common secret that is used further to derive key material. This function is only available if Key MCrypto Key Prepare Function Enabled is set to TRUE. Available via Key M.h
